name: Seerr
description: Seerr, a requests page for Jellyfin users. Reelix already has requests in Starboard, so most people do not need it.
author: TheMightyTRexUK

changed: Plainer wording in the text and help pages. How it works has not changed.
**Logo description:** where its logo stands on its own, a screen reader says "Seerr logo", the plug-in's name, instead of a description of the symbol.

added: **A logo** in Settings, Plug-ins and in the Catalogue.
changed: Needs Starboard with plug-in API 1.14 or later. A Starboard with an older plug-in API keeps version 1.0.0.

added: Seerr as a plug-in, outside the main install, on its own page on your home network.
